_README: TEN VIDEOS. Five gameplay, five development. English, global — Roye's ruling.
NO STORE DATE ANYWHERE. Every call to action is 'play now in your browser', because a
'coming soon' that sits for two months reads as a stalled project. Grep this file for
'App Store', 'Google Play', 'coming soon' or 'soon' and you should find nothing.
THE DEV FOOTAGE IS THE CURRENT BUILD, NOT THE BUG. Every one of these bugs is fixed, so
none of them can be filmed. The captions tell what went wrong over footage of the app as it
is today. That is stated here so nobody later mistakes the B-roll for a reproduction — and
no caption claims to be showing the defect.
Timings are seconds. cut.mjs REFUSES a spec whose first cue starts after 0.5s or whose
duration exceeds 60s, so the research's two hard rules cannot be forgotten here.
EVERY CLAIM IS CHECKED AGAINST A SOURCE, NOT AGAINST A HANDOFF THAT REPEATS IT. Three captions
failed that check on 2026-08-28 and were rewritten:
- play-tie said 'Nobody wins' over a frame reading a green tick and YOU WIN. The hand does tie,
but the per-board frame under the sentence said the opposite word. Retimed so the tie caption
lands on the TIE GAME 2-2 screen, which is on screen from t=10s. Same class as the bug that
nearly shipped: a true aggregate over a frame that contradicts it.
- dev-signin said 'For four months'. NO SOURCE. The only 'four months' in vamos_handoffs is
h92, which is the ACHIEVEMENTS bug. The clone is shallow (history starts 2026-08-22) so git
cannot date it either. Replaced with the figure h74 does establish: it was never shown to
anyone anonymous.
- dev-invite said '3,140 codes'. THREE SOURCES, THREE NUMBERS: h107 says 3,140, h101 says
3,173, and referral_links today holds 1,960. The count is not stable, so the count is gone.
What IS verified stays: every code len=8 (min=max=8 in the live table), every screen accepted
6 (maxLength={6}, h101), referral_redemptions = 0.

videos.payoff: The sign-in entry was never shown to anyone anonymous, because an anonymous player IS a user.
videos.caption: Our sign-in button was invisible to everyone who had not signed in. The check was 'is there a user'. Anonymous players are users. Play free in your browser.

videos.caption: Every invite code we ever issued was unusable. The database made 8 characters. Every screen accepted 6. Zero redemptions in the history of the product. Play free in your browser.

videos.payoff: The achievements screen could only ever say 0/36 — server and client never agreed on a field name.
videos.caption: Our achievements screen could only ever say 0 of 24. The server and the app never agreed what to call the field. Play free in your browser.
videos.captionNote: THE-NEGLECTED 2026-09-03 — was '0 of 36'. achievement_definitions holds 36 rows but only 24 are is_active=true, so 24 is the denominator a player actually sees. (An earlier report of '12' counted the client-side ACHIEVEMENTS array in utils/achievements.ts, which is a different, smaller list — that figure was wrong.)

videos.payoff: The contrast test was measuring a screen dimmed to 60% — for weeks.
videos.caption: Our accessibility test measures colour contrast. It was running on a screen dimmed to 60% the whole time. Play free in your browser.

videos.payoff: A tie told BOTH players they had lost, because the code only knew win and not-win.
videos.caption: When a hand tied, we told both players they lost. The code knew 'win' and 'not win'. A tie is neither. Play free in your browser.
